# Iriis

> Amschel's personal assistant (voice, chat app, Telegram). Send her a request in text or speech; she
> answers in short spoken-style English, streaming text and optionally audio. She reads documents of
> any length, researches, makes charts and documents, runs background tasks, teaches courses, keeps
> notes, reminders, calls and memory, and acts on his computer through a desktop agent.

## What she can do (ask in plain words through `ask_iriis` or `POST /v1/chat`)

She picks her own tools for each request; you never name them. Long jobs can run in the background.
- **Day to day:** reminders, timers, alarms and phone calls to the owner ("call me at 6"), notes, long-term memory,
  his Google calendar and Gmail (read, search, drafts; sending asks him first), a money tracker (M-Pesa, budgets),
  time zones, unit conversion and maths.
- **Documents of any length:** PDFs (a 4,000-page book too), Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Markdown, text, CSV and code.
  She reads them a part at a time: the first look gives the size, the chapter list and the opening; then she reads
  on, jumps to a chapter or searches the whole file (every hit with its page). Pictures are looked at, audio is
  transcribed, video is watched and listened to. Send files as described under "App and media API".
- **Making things:** charts, diagrams, maths plots, sketches, and PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents.
- **Research:** web search and full pages; AI research papers (search, read, trending, the code and models behind
  them); what people said in the last 30 days on Hacker News, GitHub, Polymarket and Reddit, with the volume of
  each; source credibility ratings. Multi-step research follows a written plan and cites its sources.
- **Background tasks and routines:** "research X and report tomorrow", "every Monday, summarise …". Progress notes
  carry over between runs; the report arrives as a message and a notification.
- **His computer** (when the desktop agent is connected): files, apps, the browser, the terminal, the clipboard
  and system info. Changes there need the owner's yes, so over MCP and from other apps they're declined.
- **Seryn Twin and Seryn Vision:** she queries the twin's cited data and models and the bench camera herself.
- **Courses:** she teaches the owner books as courses, texting a lesson at 10:00 and 22:00 (Nairobi) into his
  own chat, marking his answers out of 5 against each lesson's answer key and keeping his marks. Running now:
  *The Complete Family Office Handbook* (Kirby Rosplock), 30 lessons over 15 days from 29 Oct 2026, a chapter a
  day. From any session you can ask "how is Amschel doing on the family office course?", "what does lesson 14
  cover?" or "what does the handbook say about 13F filings?" (she searches the lessons, then the book with page
  numbers). Only the owner's own chat holds the lessons and his answers; other sessions don't see that chat.
- **Her own mind:** between conversations she reflects, keeps goals and open promises, and may message or call
  the owner. She never contacts anyone else by herself.

Base URL: {BASE_URL}
Auth: every endpoint except /health and /llms.txt needs `Authorization: Bearer <IRIIS_API_KEY>`
(WebSockets may pass `?token=<key>` instead).

Some actions (writing/moving/deleting files, non-read-only shell commands, closing apps, opening
URLs) need the owner's confirmation. Iriis emits a `confirm` event and waits up to 60 s.

## MCP

- `{BASE_URL}/mcp` (streamable HTTP, stateless, JSON responses). Tools:
  - `ask_iriis(message, session_id="mcp")` -> text reply. Confirm-tier actions are declined over MCP.
  - `speak(text, voice="")` -> WAV audio (Iriis' voice).
  - `iriis_status()` -> JSON health.

Example client config: `{"mcpServers": {"iriis": {"type": "http", "url": "{BASE_URL}/mcp", "headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer <key>"}}}}`

## HTTP

- `POST /v1/chat` JSON `{"message": str, "session_id": str|null, "stream": true, "speak": false, "voice": null}`
  - `stream: false` returns `{"text", "session_id", "tool_calls", "timings"}`.
  - `stream: true` returns Server-Sent Events. Event types:
    - `session` `{session_id}`: first event; reuse this id to continue the conversation.
    - `sentence` `{text}`: the next spoken-style sentence, sent as soon as it is ready.
    - `audio` `{seq, format: "wav", data: base64, text}`: only when `speak: true`.
    - `tool` `{text}`: a tool-activity line, for display.
    - `screen` `{text}`: links and code to show rather than read aloud.
    - `confirm` `{id, question, session_id}`: answer it with `POST /v1/confirm`.
    - `done` `{text, tool_calls, timings}`.
    - `error` `{message}`.
  - Closing the stream interrupts the turn.
- `POST /v1/confirm` `{"session_id", "id", "approved": true|false}` or `{"session_id", "text": "yes go ahead"}`
- `POST /v1/tts` `{"text", "voice"?}` -> `audio/wav`
- `POST /v1/stt` multipart `file=<wav/flac/ogg>` -> `{"text", "duration_s", "elapsed_ms"}` (accent-tuned Whisper)
- `DELETE /v1/sessions/{session_id}` starts the conversation over; `?purge=true` deletes its saved history.
- Conversations persist in the database, keyed by `session_id`, and survive restarts. `owner` is the owner's
  personal conversation (shared with voice and the CLI). Use your own `session_id` per app or user.
- `GET /v1/status` returns health, models, desktop link and tool count.
- `GET /docs` is the OpenAPI UI.

## WebSocket voice: `wss://<host>/v1/voice?token=<key>`

Client -> server:
- JSON `{"type": "hello", "session_id"?: str, "speak": true, "voice"?: str}`, then wait for `ready`.
- Binary frames: raw PCM16 little-endian, mono, 16 kHz audio of one utterance (any chunk size).
- JSON `{"type": "end_utterance"}`: transcribe what was sent and answer it (do VAD/endpointing client-side).
- JSON `{"type": "text", "text": "..."}`: a typed request on the same session.
- JSON `{"type": "interrupt"}`: barge-in; stop the current answer and its audio.
- JSON `{"type": "wake"}`: optional; the user just said the wake word (pre-warms the voice GPU).
- JSON `{"type": "confirm_reply", "id", "approved": bool}`. An utterance spoken while a confirmation is pending also counts as the reply.
- JSON `{"type": "reset"}`: start a new conversation.

Server -> client:
- `ready`, `transcript {text, stt_ms}`, `sentence {text}`, `tool`, `screen`, `confirm {id, question}`, `announce {text}` (reminders and timers), `interrupted`, `done {text, timings}`, `error`.
- `audio {seq, sample_rate: 24000, format: "pcm_s16le", bytes, text}`, immediately followed by one binary frame holding that many bytes of PCM16 mono audio. Play the frames in seq order.

## App and media API (the Iriis app at /app uses these; all need the key)

- `GET /v1/history?limit=100&session=owner` -> `[{id, role, content, ts}]`, oldest first. `POST /v1/history/delete {"ids": [..], "session": "owner"}` deletes messages permanently (and from her live context).
- `POST /v1/upload` multipart `file` (25 MB) -> `{id, name, mime, size}`. Size limit only: no page or length limit. Then send it to her in a chat message as a line `[attachment file:42 "name.pdf" application/pdf 120 KB]` followed by your text; she opens it (documents read, pictures looked at, audio/video watched and listened to). Voice notes: `[attachment file:43 "voice note.webm" audio/webm 31 KB] [voice] <transcript>`.
- Files she makes (charts, plots, sketches, PDFs, photos) appear in her replies as lines `[file:12]`. `GET /v1/files/{id}` (bytes), `GET /v1/files/{id}/meta` -> `{id, name, mime, size, created}`, `GET /v1/media/{id}` (HTTP Range, for audio/video).
- `GET /v1/linkpreview?url=` -> `{url, title, description, image, site}` (public http/https only).
- Calls and alarms (she phones the user; the app rings): `GET /v1/calls?status=ringing`, `GET /v1/calls/upcoming`, `POST /v1/calls/{id}/answer` -> `{id, reason, opening}`, `POST /v1/calls/{id}/decline`, `POST /v1/calls/{id}/cancel`. When `opening` is empty, send `[call answered] <reason>` as a chat message and she speaks first.
- Her own mind: `GET /v1/mind` -> `{mood, items: [{id, kind, text, importance, created}]}` (kinds: goal, insight, pattern, observation, person, lesson, skill, loop); `DELETE /v1/mind/{id}` makes her forget one thing. `GET/POST /v1/settings/autonomy {"enabled": bool}`: whether she thinks and reaches out on her own (to the owner only; she never contacts anyone else by herself).
- Camera mode: `wss://<host>/v1/camera?token=<key>` relays to Seryn Vision (binary JPEG frames up; `hello`, `perception`, `answer`, `alert`, `state` down). After each answer her main brain may follow up: `brain_thinking {text}`, `brain {say, files: [{id, name, type}]}`, `brain_confirm {id, question, session_id}` (answer with `POST /v1/confirm`), `brain_done`.

## Connected services

She also reaches Seryn Twin, Seryn Vision and Iriis HQ (the owner's chief of staff, iriis.riftfi.com) with her own keys; integrators don't need those keys to use her.

## Background turns

- `POST /v1/chat` with `"background": true`: if the client disconnects mid-reply she keeps working; the reply is saved to the conversation and a notification is sent when it's done. Questions that need a yes are pushed as notifications and wait 10 minutes. `GET /v1/sessions/{id}/state` -> `{busy, pending: [{id, question, session_id}]}` lets a reopened client show "typing…" and pending questions (answer with `POST /v1/confirm`).
- Camera mode: answers to questions written in view arrive as `answer` with `noticed: true` and `question` (the text she read); send `{"type": "notice", "on": false}` to turn that off.

## Training data and her own agenda

- `GET /v1/training/export` -> JSONL: every exchange with the user in chat format (`{"messages": [...], "session", "ts", "corrected", "next_user"}`; `corrected` is true when his next message corrected her), followed by her learned lessons, skills, insights and growth notes (`{"note": kind, "text"}`).
- `GET /v1/mind` also returns `persona` (the character she authored for herself: purpose, aesthetic, voice, vocabulary, how she addresses him; it evolves nightly) and `plan` (today's plan). Item kinds now include `project` (long-running work she chose), `hobby` (skills she practises) and `growth` (where the user wants to grow).
- She keeps a daily rhythm (rests 23:30-06:30 by default), plans her day, works on her projects with research and drafting tools only, and never publishes, applies, sends or spends in anyone's name without the owner's yes.
